acceptanceCriteria.text: Specify a complete logical decomposition, interaction/data flows, and an explicit owner for each authoritative fact (objective, authorization, task graph, readiness, resource allocation, execution, workspace, external effects, evidence, integration, acceptance).

Define durable identities, lifecycle/transition ownership, concurrency and conflict handling, at-least-once commands, uncertain side effects, restart/reconciliation and safe retry without claiming impossible exactly-once guarantees.
Define security/trust boundaries, least privilege, secrets/context treatment, resource/cost optimization, evidence/provenance and human decision escalation.
Define interfaces and deployment-neutral failure behavior, including absent resources and temporary provider unavailability; document architectural decisions and rejected alternatives.

Trace all 36 Product Capability Model IDs and the 18 product-level end-to-end scenarios to structural responsibilities and certification seams; separate Phase 4 implementation planning and technical platform selection.

Add a well-placed architecture document and link it from the architecture index; review relative links and documentation-only diff; publish a ready-for-review PR without merging or changing executable code, existing contracts or other Issues.

issue.title: docs: define outcome-driven target product architecture
